finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: The file name 'grades' is derived from an attacker-controlled source, such as a command line argument or an environment variable.
finding.assumptions: The file name 'grades' is derived from an attacker-controlled source, such as a command line argument or an environment variable.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: The code does not validate or sanitize user input before using it in a dynamic memory allocation.
finding.assumptions: User input is used to determine the number of students, which is then used in a dynamic memory allocation.

finding.title: Buffer Over-read / Buffer Over-write
finding.trigger: The code uses 'strdup' to duplicate strings without checking the length of the input strings.
finding.assumptions: The input strings 'first' and 'last' are derived from user input and are not validated for length.

finding.title: Improper Release of Memory before Returning from a Function
finding.trigger: The code does not check if 'student_ptrs[i]' is NULL before calling 'free' on it.
finding.assumptions: The code assumes that 'student_ptrs[i]' is always valid and not NULL.
